selection: The best configuration is the highest recall@10 on all 32 answerable questions. There is no held-out split. If a hybrid uses a BM25 analyzer other than the phase 2 suffix list, that analyzer was chosen on these same questions.
hit_rule: same source_id and abs(retrieved pdf_page - gold pdf_page) <= 1; one retrieved page credits one gold page

not_run.reason: Dense BGE-M3 is not in fastembed 0.9.1, the latest release on PyPI. This VM has no GPU and torch is not installed, so the model was not loaded.

comparison.note: best is the hybrid baseline; the interval is the next config minus that baseline
